text:
alex: Heads-up: seeing a high-rate of small hallucinations from the hosted text-gen model since 17:40 UTC. Customer impact (search assistant) ~5% failed answers. I want to push a binary+model hotfix and do a greypass (skip canary) — customer-facing outage risk if we wait. Asking for expedited approval.

ops-oncall: Can you post the short blast radius and rollback plan? Need to confirm no config drift.

alex: Blast radius: hosted text-gen pool in us-east1; ~12% of requests hitting new quant path. Rollback: immediate image revert to prod tag `prod-2026-03-19-9f2a` with traffic cutover (deploybot rollback command). Smoke test plan below.

maria: Smoke tests I ran locally: inference metric p99 stable; unit sanity good. For prod, we should run `smoke/gen-smoke --model rk-v2 --qpath fast` on 3 nodes, then run synthetic prompt set (~20 prompts) before cut. I'll own smoke.

deploybot: deploybot: Starting expedited deploy workflow. Request ID: DB-61823. Canary required: false (greypass requested). Please react with :white_check_mark: to approve, or type `veto` to block. Automated checks: artifact-signature OK, infra-health OK, e2e: pending.

jason: +1 from infra, I've validated the image signature and node drain script. Recommend greypass only if smoke passes in <10m. :thumbsup:

release-council: Note: this changes the tokenizer marshalling; release notes must mention regression fix and rollback instructions. I can draft a one-paragraph.

ops-oncall: Two asks before greenlight: 1) confirm no DB migrations (yes/no) 2) POST-metrics checks we want to watch (latency, error-rate, hallucination-rate).

alex: No DB migrations. Watch keys: `textgen.latency.p50/p95/p99`, `textgen.errors.rate`, `textgen.eval.hallucination_rate`. Will pin the model version `rk-v2-hotfix-03` in the rollout.

maria: Smoke started on node set A (3 nodes) at 17:46. Synthetic pass currently 12/20, failing ones are trivial tokenization edgecases I fixed in the build. Re-running with patch. ETA 4m.

jason: ops approves conditional on smoke success and release notes link.

alex: Updated build pushed; smoke now 20/20 on node set A. No infra regressions.

deploybot: deploybot: Automated e2e checks passed (15/15). Greypass approval votes: jason, ops-oncall, maria. No veto recorded. Proceeding to deploy to us-east1 pool. Command: `deploybot deploy --id DB-61823 --image prod-hotfix-9f3b --pin-model rk-v2-hotfix-03 --region us-east1 --greypass`

deploybot: deploybot: Rolling out to 40% traffic (step 1) — live. Monitor pods: https://dash.internal/rollouts/DB-61823

ops-oncall: Monitoring dashboards now. I set alert for hallucination_rate > 1.5% and error-rate > 0.5%.

alex: Noting release notes (draft): "Hotfix: Fix regression causing spurious hallucinations in rk-v2 inference pipeline. Pinned model `rk-v2-hotfix-03`. Rollback: revert to `prod-2026-03-19-9f2a`." Link: https://go/redwood/release-notes/DB-61823

release-council: Draft looks good. I'll publish after final verification.

deploybot: deploybot: Step 2: 100% traffic switch complete. Deployment succeeded. All automated checks remain green.

maria: Post-deploy smoke: 20/20; manual spot-checks ok.

ops-oncall: Observability: latency unchanged, error-rate down to 0.12%, hallucination_rate dropped to 0.4%. Good.

alex: Thanks team. Marking as expedited-hotfix closed. Will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow with root cause and preventative actions.

jason: +1 on the PM. Good containment.

deploybot: deploybot: Deploy DB-61823 closed. Logs: /var/log/deploys/DB-61823.log

maria: quick note: opened a canary test to validate quant path across other regions; will report if something odd shows up.

ops-oncall: thumbs for followup. :white_check_mark:

alex: closing thread. Thanks all :party_popper:
